evidence: The body queries attribute context status and, when enabled and the provider pointer at the second argument is non-null, fetches nested attribute 0x1b and classifies its float into integer result buckets; it returns -2 on unavailable/failed lookup and otherwise returns 3, -2, or the converted value. Caller f_7000f800a4 stores the result among sibling attribute results. decompiled/main/main_0112.c:37618-37663; caller decompiled/main/main_0112.c:6450-6454.

The body initializes a nested player attribute block: it selects a status/default value, initializes fields at offsets 0x24c-0x258, obtains a related record pointer and ID, then calls populate_nested_player_attribute_block on the input block. It is invoked from an object initialization sequence. decompiled/main/main_0111.c:11791-11849; related initializer caller decompiled/main/main_0111.c:11765-11788.

The body initializes output float to -1.0, checks two helper predicates, reads an index from argument three and compares it with 0x75 and 0x79; for selected indices it calls player_attribute_get_float or evaluate_indexed_ranked_record_metric, storing the resulting float. decompiled/main/main_0052.c:42966-43017.

The body initializes output int to -1, requires a global context pointer, queries status 0x13 and on status 4 resolves a nested provider, fetches float property 0x44, converts to signed integer, and stores it. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:869-912.

The body tests the selected record through context_selected_record_has_supported_status when a record pointer exists; otherwise queries context status 0x14 and returns whether it equals 4. Stores normalized boolean to output pointer. decompiled/main/main_0052.c:45120-45148.
